note: Three shows picked by hand each week. Times in UTC; the app shows them in the listener's own time.

picks.title: Strangers Live w/ '89 the Brainchild & Fatboi Sharif
picks.why: Underground hip hop from Bushwick: rapper Fatboi Sharif and '89 the Brainchild, with DJ Kohai and DJ Boogaveli, going from rap and soul to jungle and spoken word.

picks.title: Songlines • Sarolta Zalatnay w/ Jimmy Trash
picks.why: An hour on Sarolta Zalatnay, the voice of Hungarian beat and psychedelia in the late sixties and seventies.

picks.title: Elope w/ Eleni Poulou
picks.why: The show of Eleni Poulou, Berlin musician and poet who played keyboards in The Fall: records, voices and guests, wherever they lead.
